purpose: Canonical full-replay validation after Matrix 24 screening hid fast-pan and weak/low-frequency safety failures.
invariant: Production architecture 0 remained unchanged. Mode 16 kept mode 14 event-only corrected disocclusion for local motion and blended event interpretation back to raw disocclusion under coherent camera motion.
interpretation: Mode 16 solved the camera-motion regression while retaining the moving-flash gate, but the canonical 36-case perceptual sweep exposed two safety gaps hidden by screening: 5 Hz attenuation collapses near 14% across ordinary contrasts because opposition-qualified risk decays between slower half-cycles, and the 4-code stimulus remains below useful sequence authority. WCAG also fails red_full 12 Hz and luminance_quarter 5/7.5 Hz. The next architecture therefore extends risk only on verified stationary repetition and qualifies tiny changes only after an opposing signed reversal; it does not globally lower instantaneous thresholds.
evidence_serialization: Repository copies are UTF-8 LF JSON serializations of the artifact JSON values.
